Applied by SeedRun after projection and normalisation; an entry whose expected value no longer matches is reported stale and NOT applied (D4). An entry with "sources" applies only to the named seed sources ("pickle", "webapi"; absent = every source): the rows CDISC-METADATA-ISSUES flags "(seed?)"
